_comment: Skeleton config for a new bank. Copy this folder to banks/<BankName>/ and edit fields below. Anything starting with '_' is a comment and ignored by the loader.
name: Template_Bank
_comment_use_nse: Optional. Default true — engine pulls corporate filings from the NSE announcements API for this bank's ticker. Set to false for banks whose IR page is curated + exhaustive (an adapter.py likely filters it cleanly already) and you don't want NSE adding duplicate / off-topic filings (earnings-call intimations, analyst-meet schedules, etc.).
_comment_doc_types: Optional. Per-bank narrowing of settings.json:doc_types_whitelist. Omit to inherit the global list (which is currently {investor_presentation, press_release, financial_result}). To fetch only one type for this bank, list just that type here.
